items.name: instagram-feed
items.title: Instagram Feed
items.description: Instagram posts, reels and carousels as a responsive grid. Async Server Component for Next.js App Router with 12 demo posts included; connect a real account later with npx electricblaze connect instagram.
items.author: ElectricBlaze <contact@electricblaze.com>
items.docs: Render <InstagramFeed limit={8} /> in any App Router page or footer. It shows 12 demo posts until ELECTRICBLAZE_API_KEY is set. Check the setup with: npx electricblaze doctor
